Governing document for faculty: the AUNBT Full-Time (Group 1) collective agreement 2016-2020, in force on the reference date 2018-03-12 (Art. 47.01). Its Art. 32E (maternity leave), 32F (parental leave), 32G (return to normal duties), 32D (short-term sick leave), 32C (special leave), 20A (workload reduction), 23A (probation and tenure) and 35 (fringe benefits) supply the components.

The ESA lengths are those in force on 2018-03-12, before Bill 44 (Royal Assent 2018-03-16): maternity leave up to 17 weeks, child care leave 37 consecutive weeks, combined maximum 52 weeks (leave_limits). The agreement's maternity and parental leave restate the statutory leaves without adding length, so c1 and c2 carry statute_source (schema, statute_source).

Birth parent chain: maternity leave (ESA) 17 -> parental leave (ESA child care) 37, combined maximum 52; SEB top-up to 95% within each leave (c3 within c1, c4 within c2); EI maternity 15 from week 2 (c5 concurrent_with c1, offset 1) -> EI parental 35 (c6 consecutive_after c5).

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave (ESA child care) 37 with the SEB top-up to 95% within it (c4 within c2); EI parental 35 from week 2 of the leave (c6 concurrent_with c2, offset 1, roles nonbirth).

SEB timing: Arts. 32E.03 and 32F.03 maintain salary at 95% 'for the period of her/the leave' and describe the SEB as making up the difference between EI received and 95%. Coded as envelopes from the leave's start with no waiting-week offset; flagged ambiguous on c3 and c4 (the alternative reading would give the top-ups start_offset_weeks 1 as in checklist §5 example 1).

SEB eligibility: probationary, tenure-track and tenured Employees, and term appointees in the second or later consecutive year; no SEB in the first academic year of a term appointment (32E.04, 32F.04).

Tenure: maternity and parental leave normally count as service toward tenure, promotion and sabbatical (32E.03, 32F.03); leave without pay normally does not count toward tenure or promotion (23A.01, 24A.02, 32C.09). The good-cause deferral of assessment (c11) is the tenure-clock provision the parental articles point to. Faculty may also defer the automatic promotion review by one or two years (24A.04(a)); not a tenure clock, not coded.

Not components: court leave (32A), public office leave (32B), bereavement leave (32H), retraining leave (33), sabbatical leave and its deferral for personal hardship (31A.12): none can be taken for a birth or adoption. Art. 57 (accommodation of employees with disabilities) is a disability accommodation, not a pregnancy accommodation (checklist §1).

The 'Compulsory Retirement for Employees with Long Term Disabilities' policy named in Art. 40.01(d) is reproduced as Appendix B of the agreement. The full text of the NB Employment Standards Act (ss. 43-44.02) is not saved; its 2018 lengths are taken from Bill 44 and the GNB summary (2018_05, 2018_08).
Staff components c14 and c15 come from a 2004 HR policy captured in 2016 (version_uncertain); they cover employees not covered by a collective agreement and are not counted.
No calendar is stated in weeks; the agreement names Fall, Winter and Summer terms without lengths, so calendar is omitted.

statutory_floor.statute: Employment Standards Act: maternity and child care leave (SNB 1982 c. E-7.2, s. 43-44)
